# Welcome to Pull Request

Thank you for your contribution! Please refer to the [contributing guidelines](https://github.com/ruyisdk/board-docs/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) for more details.

## If you are working on board documentation

We appreciate your effort in improving the RuyiSDK board documentation.

If you're creating a new board or example, please refer to our templates:

- [English board template](https://github.com/ruyisdk/board-docs/blob/main/templates/%5Bboard-name%5D/README.md)
- [Chinese board template](https://github.com/ruyisdk/board-docs/blob/main/templates/%5Bboard-name%5D/README_zh.md)
- [Chinese example template](https://github.com/ruyisdk/board-docs/blob/main/templates/%5Bboard-name%5D/%5Bexample-name%5D/README_zh.md)
- [English example template (optional)](https://github.com/ruyisdk/board-docs/blob/main/templates/%5Bboard-name%5D/%5Bexample-name%5D/README.md)

### Example category

For new or updated example documentation, set the `category` metadata field to one of the following values:

`getting-started`, `peripheral`, `network`, `system`, `storage`,
`power-management`, `multimedia`, `computer-vision`, `ai`, `security`,
`compression`, `gui`, `benchmark`, `application`, or `other`.

See [Example Categories](https://github.com/ruyisdk/board-docs/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#example-categories) for definitions and selection guidance.

### Checklist

- [ ] Metadata validation passes successfully
- [ ] Appropriate changes to documentation are included in the PR
- [ ] Documentation steps have been verified on the corresponding board
- [ ] i18n for documentation (optional)
